recommendations.issue: Inconsistent kitchen execution and poor food quality during peak hours
recommendations.action: Implement standardized recipe cards, conduct mandatory culinary refresher training for all line cooks, and institute strict chef-driven quality checks before any dish leaves the pass.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significant reduction in food quality complaints and higher consistency across all shifts.

recommendations.issue: Kitchen bottlenecks and front-of-house understaffing causing long wait times
recommendations.action: Re-engineer kitchen station layouts to streamline ticket flow, optimize scheduling using peak-hour sales forecasting, and implement a digital kitchen display system (KDS) to track order times.
recommendations.expected_impact: Decreased table turn times, faster service, and improved overall throughput during rushes.

recommendations.issue: Staff burnout, understaffing, and inadequate training leading to poor guest service
recommendations.action: Launch a comprehensive customer service training program focusing on de-escalation and hospitality, and review staffing levels to ensure adequate shift coverage and reduce employee fatigue.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved staff morale, friendlier guest interactions, and a noticeable drop in negative service reviews.

recommendations.issue: Menu pricing misalignment with customer expectations on food quality and portions
recommendations.action: Conduct a comprehensive menu engineering audit to either enhance perceived value through portion and presentation adjustments or recalibrate price points to match customer expectations.
recommendations.expected_impact: Better alignment between cost and perceived value, leading to increased customer satisfaction and repeat visits.
